messages:
tess_docs: Quick sync before I open a tiny docs PR: adding a 'tenant migration' subsection to the SOC2 / audit logs page. Need to lock SDK names, curl example, and a short legal-friendly sentence.
kai_security: use the phrase 'tenant migration' in user-facing docs. call out that legal holds block TTL-based deletion and that exports are the exporter's responsibility. :lock:
omar_eng: SDK v2 is `set_retention_policy(...)` and holds are `HoldsClient.create(...)` — it returns an object with an `id`. Also note exports are async and can take a few minutes.
tess_docs: draft python snippet (please sanity-check):
```
from redwood import AuditClient, HoldsClient
ac = AuditClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
ac.set_retention_policy(tenant_id="acct_999", ttl_days=90)
hold = HoldsClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY").create(tenant_id="acct_999", reason="legal review")
print(hold.id)
```

# curl export (async, optional redaction)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acct_999","from":"2025-06-01","to":"2025-06-30","redact_sensitive":true}'

lucy_legal: Suggested sentence to include exactly: "During tenant migration, audit events remain subject to the tenant's configured retention policy unless a legal hold is applied; exports initiated by the customer remain the responsibility of the exporter and must be protected per contract."
tess_docs: adding that verbatim. link-checker: scanning draft branch... found 1 missing internal anchor and 1 external vendor URL change.
link-checker: fixes queued  please re-run after patch.
tess_docs: will fix anchors, include FAQ bullet "What happens to logs during tenant migration?" with three bullets (retention follows tenant policy; legal holds override TTL; exports are customer's responsibility), and then open PR. Assigning review to @kai_security @lucy_legal @omar_eng. PR will include snippets and the one-line contract-friendly clause in an appendix. last_message_ts: 1795554350
